name: 元气甜妹
design_description: A young adult female voice speaking standard Mandarin Chinese. Bright, sweet and youthful anime heroine timbre, cheerful and energetic, with a natural smile in the voice. Clear consonants, lively rising intonation, playful short giggles for 嘿嘿, and warm encouraging delivery. Natural conversational speed, clean studio recording.

natural-r1.description_suffix: Keep the delivery natural and relaxed while remaining cheerful and youthful. Use a comfortable bright pitch with clear, lightly smiling speech. Avoid a nasal whiny or coquettish delivery, drawn-out squeaky vowels, shouting and sudden loud exclamations. Use a gentle onset and moderate conversational energy.
